snippet.title: Sigma Star Saga DX - Console/PC Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Sigma Star Saga DX, the classic shoot-'em-up/RPG, returns on modern platforms! Top-down adventure and exploration combine with intense side-scrolling space-shooter battles as you go behind enemy lines to save mankind from annihilation! Visit six planets, power-up with awesome tools, and customize your ship's weaponry with more than 20,000 Gun Data combinations. Launching on Switch, PS5, and Steam in early 2026, with physical preorders coming to Switch and PS5 in the months ahead!
Get more info at: https://wayforward.com/games/sigma-star-saga-dx
